title: Um Dia Fora do Jogo
summary: Sunday 2027-01-31, a full day off for all twenty-five players, coaches, mentors, support staff and administration: the LA Galaxy and San Diego FC friendly at Dignity Health Sports Park (2-2) and the Lakers against the Phoenix Suns at Crypto.com Arena (118-116). In a half-time challenge Nathan Hall (Academy White) makes a mid-court shot that secures a USD 20,000 donation to a Los Angeles community technology programme for young people.
keyEvents: 8:46 — Adrian announces a day without training, review or scrim talk; players may sit with anyone, not only their own team.
13:00 — LA Galaxy 2-2 San Diego FC; Arthur Fletcher attends the first half with Owen and receives a Galaxy cap from Adrian; Nathan appears on the stadium screen.

18:07 — The delegation watches Los Angeles Lakers vs Phoenix Suns from a reserved area; the arena presents the delegation and Adrian Vale as founder, noting Kairos will play the LCS and professional Counter-Strike in 2027.

20:29 — The Lakers' half-time challenge picks Nathan; after three stages he attempts a mid-court shot, which goes in, securing a USD 20,000 donation to a community technology access programme (not a prize to Nathan).

21:16 — The Lakers win 118-116; the footage of the shot circulates on the arena's social channels; Adrian asks that Nathan be consulted before any republication and that it not become a marketing campaign without authorization.
23:46 — Adrian tells Emily he wants more such days; the CCT starts in one week and the LCS in fifteen days.
consequences: Nathan Hall's shot makes him briefly the centre of attention without any link to a League match; Kairos will ask his consent before any use of the video.
canonIntroduced: A USD 20,000 donation to a Los Angeles community technology access programme results from Nathan Hall's mid-court shot at the Lakers game of 2027-01-31.
The whole organisation attends the LA Galaxy and Lakers games on 2027-01-31.
continuityNotes: Players are not told to avoid the shot's popularity; a later episode records a community invitation from the programme.
Episode 124 and later refer to the trip.
realWorldReferences: LA Galaxy, San Diego FC, Los Angeles Lakers, Phoenix Suns and the two venues are real-world references; the results are fictional-canon for the Kairos Universe.

sourceReferences.locator: Episódio 120 — Um Dia Fora do Jogo

confirmedFacts: LA Galaxy vs San Diego FC ended 2-2 (Galaxy 1-0 at 22', San Diego equalised before half-time and led 2-1 at 63', Galaxy tied from a corner).
Lakers 118, Suns 116 after 116-116 with sixteen seconds left; Nathan Hall made the final stage shot.
Arthur Fletcher attended only the football and returned to the campus with organised transport.
Nathan Hall is a member of Academy White and is a retro-console repair hobbyist who works at the Maker Lab.
unconfirmedDetails: Name of the community programme and of the sponsoring company, and how the donation was delivered.
notes: Kairos Gaming is the public name of the Counter-Strike Main team.
